facilities.kind_note_en: Incineration plant plus the resource recycling facility, which processes cans/PET bottles, glass bottles, other non-burnable waste and bulky waste (56 t/day). The recycling facility opened on 1 April 2026 and replaced the crushing/sorting plant and Recycle Plaza at 西部総合処理センター. Since 1 April 2026 it is the only self-haul site for households.

Until 31 March 2026 it was the household self-haul site. The building also houses the environment department offices (美化第1課, 施設管理課).

facilities.name_ja: 芦屋市環境処理センター
facilities.kind_note_en: Incinerator plus a non-burnable waste building (不燃物処理棟) where self-hauled non-burnable waste is unloaded, and a wood crusher that self-haulers use for large amounts of wood. The exact processing method for bulky waste is not described on the pages used. The city plans to rebuild the plant; from fiscal 2030 or later burnable waste is to be sent via a transfer facility in Ashiya to Kobe for incineration.
